lanes.title: Post-composition width-by-partition correctness grid
lanes.mechanism: Evaluate widths 1,4,8,16,32 against partition counts 16,32,64,128 only after R17-R66 candidates are composed, retaining every cell through the correctness and count screen.
lanes.target: strong_rho.rs plus the GHS development ECBench spec
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any cell fails planted-log recovery, counted/counter-free answer parity, or its preregistered trajectory policy.
lanes.measurement_gate: Source-bound profile, host A/A, interleaved ABAB development panel, then one frozen primary and at most one sensitivity configuration on holdout.

lanes.title: Explicit masked tails for partial batches
lanes.mechanism: Represent every partial batch with an explicit active-lane mask so retry and terminal tails neither read nor charge inactive lanes.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any active logical item is visited other than exactly once, or any inactive lane is dereferenced.
lanes.measurement_gate: Sanitizer/UB screen, exact trajectory and scalar-operation parity for every tail length, then isolated full-batch versus tail-heavy controls.

lanes.title: Retry-lane stable compaction
lanes.mechanism: Compact unresolved lookahead lanes between attempts while carrying the original lane id and charging every attempted addition.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A compacted lane changes its selected jump, coefficient update, retry count, final point, or charged attempted work relative to the scalar lane oracle.
lanes.measurement_gate: Multi-q retry-heavy deterministic panel followed by phase-isolated ABAB only if complete counts remain authoritative.

lanes.title: Structure-of-arrays Fq3 batch representation
lanes.mechanism: Store the three cubic coefficients in separate aligned lane arrays while preserving the scalar abstract-operation accounting.
prerequisites: M1 attributes material time to lane field arithmetic
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: AoS and SoA paths disagree for any coefficient, trajectory field, collision scalar, or scalar counter vector.
lanes.measurement_gate: Exact lane parity, sanitizer checks, source-bound host features, then isolated scalar-AoS versus scalar-SoA ABAB.

lanes.title: Portable SIMD u32 field lanes
lanes.mechanism: Vectorize widened u32 lane products and reductions behind the same batch-field trait for the admitted q<2^31 domain.
lanes.target: FastF3 behind a future ghs_batch_field trait
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any vector lane differs from the scalar reducer on boundaries, random deterministic vectors, partial masks, or fallback hosts.
lanes.measurement_gate: Scalar counts stay unchanged; vector instructions are separately recorded; isolated per-host ABAB and cold E2E must both improve.

lanes.title: Source-bound SIMD dispatch and scalar fallback
lanes.mechanism: Select scalar, portable-vector, or architecture-specific kernels from recorded host features without changing mathematical or accounting authority.
lanes.target: main.rs and a future ghs_batch_field dispatch module
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Forced dispatch paths disagree, an unsupported instruction can execute, or the record omits selected kernel and host features.
lanes.measurement_gate: Forced-path differential tests on every supported host class and a source/binary/feature-bound run identity.

lanes.title: Cache-aligned walker hot/cold state split
lanes.mechanism: Separate per-step point/coefficient/hash state from diagnostics and rarely used restart metadata, with alignment and size asserted at build time.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Layout conversion changes trajectory, coefficients, counters, or loses restart/cycle state.
lanes.measurement_gate: Record struct sizes/alignment and cache counters on an admitted host; require cold E2E improvement beyond A/A.

lanes.title: Jump-table hot/cold split and prefetch screen
lanes.mechanism: Keep per-step jump points and scalar deltas contiguous, move setup-only metadata cold, and screen bounded prefetch distances without changing selected jumps.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any prefetch address may be outside allocated storage, or hot/cold layouts disagree on selected jump, point, scalar, or count.
lanes.measurement_gate: Sanitizer plus exact trajectory parity, then preregistered prefetch-distance ABAB with no post-hoc distance selection.

lanes.title: Canonical distinguished-point record packing
lanes.mechanism: Pack the canonical DP key, coefficients, walker id, and provenance into a fixed schema while retaining full independent verification inputs.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel DP record, aligned with src/cryptanalysis/pollard_collab
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Pack/unpack is not byte-stable, merges opposite sign incorrectly, truncates a scalar, or accepts a record that fails aP+bQ=R.
lanes.measurement_gate: Round-trip and tamper tests first; memory/traffic comparison reports bytes and verification CPU separately.

lanes.title: Deterministic disjoint worker-start indices
lanes.mechanism: Interleave worker ids within a job-derived index interval so workers share one transition but never intentionally start the same trail.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel worker scheduler and prototype walker_index
prerequisites: fixed worker count in run identity
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any two worker/generation pairs map to the same walker index, or replay under the same job identity differs.
lanes.measurement_gate: Production PRF conformance vectors and large-domain uniqueness audit before threaded execution.

lanes.title: Shared transition and jump-table identity
lanes.mechanism: Bind every worker to one job-derived transition and jump table; only trail starts differ.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel job spec and prototype transition
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Worker-local configuration changes a transition for the same state or a record lacks the transition identity.
lanes.measurement_gate: Cross-thread and cross-process transition vectors plus exact same-job replay before collision trials.

lanes.title: Prefix-sharded distinguished-point table
lanes.mechanism: Route each canonical DP key to one power-of-two prefix shard so all coefficient records for that key meet at the same collision detector.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel DP table and prototype shard_for
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: The same key can route to different shards or two different coefficient records for one key evade comparison.
lanes.measurement_gate: Deterministic routing/collision tests, then report per-shard occupancy, table bytes, operations, and skew under admitted runs.

lanes.title: Bounded shard queues and contention accounting
lanes.mechanism: Give each DP shard a bounded submission queue and record enqueue, wait, probe, insertion, collision, and backpressure events without dropping records.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel DP table and coordinator
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: A full queue drops or reorders a record in a way that changes collision detection, or accounting fails total_submitted=processed+queued.
lanes.measurement_gate: Deterministic saturation test then isolated worker-count panel reporting wait CPU, queue depth, contention, and total work.

lanes.title: Checked-stop and overshoot accounting
lanes.mechanism: Count work through checked collision detection and retain every step performed during propagation and worker-stop latency as overshoot.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel coordinator and prototype simulate
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: total_steps differs from useful_steps+overshoot_steps, or a worker step after detection disappears from the record.
lanes.measurement_gate: Threaded forced-collision tests with injected stop delays, followed by admitted runs reporting latency, total CPU, useful work, and overshoot together.

lanes.title: Affinity and NUMA placement in run identity
lanes.mechanism: Record worker count, CPU set, affinity outcome, NUMA nodes, memory policy, queue depth, and shard policy as immutable run-identity fields.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel run schema and GHS development ECBench spec
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Requested placement differs from observed placement without invalidating the run, or two materially different placements share an identity.
lanes.measurement_gate: Pool/affinity preflight plus observed topology receipt before any worker-count scaling result is admitted.

lanes.title: Latency, total-work, and scaling-efficiency ledger
lanes.mechanism: Keep wall latency separate from total CPU and steps; compute scaling efficiency only against matched same-host worker-count controls while retaining overshoot.
lanes.target: future GHS parallel result schema/analyzer and prototype Summary
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: The record omits a required numerator/denominator, mixes host classes, or total_steps!=useful_steps+overshoot_steps.
lanes.measurement_gate: A/A per worker count, interleaved scaling panel, confidence intervals, and simultaneous reporting of latency, total CPU, total/useful steps, overshoot, DP/table work, and memory.

lanes.title: Cross-host deterministic portability and fallback gate
lanes.mechanism: Require scalar-fallback replay identity across hosts and bind any SIMD/threaded result to its source, binary, compiler, features, topology, and configuration.
lanes.target: future GHS host capsule and the R67-R83 prototype
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Two replays of the same scalar-fallback identity differ, or a host-specific result lacks enough metadata to reproduce dispatch and placement.
lanes.measurement_gate: Independent second-host scalar replay, then separately calibrated host-specific measurements; never pool unmatched hosts into one speed ratio.
